summary: Defines L2TP Attribute Value Pair extensions that carry subscriber access line identification and characteristics, as seen at the broadband access server. It also describes a mechanism for carrying this information onward, so the network can know about the customer's line.

eli5.summary: When a home connects through a phone or cable line, the network benefits from knowing details about that line. This note adds fields to a tunneling protocol to pass those details along.

questions: what is the l2tp access line information avp
how does l2tp carry subscriber line information
